Invest in a well built asphalt driveway

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_divider color=”#28343B” divider_weight=”2px” _builder_version=”4.24.0″ _module_preset=”default” width=”20%” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”20px||||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_text disabled_on=”off|off|off” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” text_font_size=”18px” text_line_height=”1.6em” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”750px” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||||false|false” custom_margin_tablet=”||||false|false” custom_margin_phone=”-20px||||false|true” custom_margin_last_edited=”on|phone” custom_padding_tablet=”” custom_padding_phone=”|18px||18px|false|true” custom_padding_last_edited=”on|phone” animation_style=”slide” animation_direction=”right” link_option_url=”Tel:318-614-3139″ hover_enabled=”0″ text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”16px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Asphalt Driveways are a great investment, but the most important factor is a well-built base. Asphalt itself is simply the wearing surface—the strength comes from the base. Base requirements vary depending on location and ground conditions, and some areas need more attention than others. The depth of asphalt also matters depending on the loads your driveway will need to support.

Proper drainage is crucial to prevent standing water or rain flowing back toward your home. Sealcoating your driveway approximately three years after paving helps protect the asphalt from cracking and drying out due to sun exposure. Protecting the edges with a rock shoulder prevents them from breaking off, and milling or cutting a transition at the road can improve tie-in and prevent flaking over time. In overlay scenarios, applying a tack coat—essentially a bonding layer—before adding a new lift of hot mix asphalt ensures long-lasting adhesion.

At Twin City Striping & Maintenance, we offer all types of solutions and options for your asphalt driveway needs, providing expert guidance and professional installation to keep your driveway durable, functional, and looking its best.
